assignmentTitle: Design and Analysis of Keys Used in Real Mechanical Systems for Torque Transmission

criteria.title: Component Identification
criteria.description: Accurate identification of shaft, hub, key, keyways, torque, and tangential force on EA-08.

criteria.title: Working Principle & Mechanics
criteria.description: Understanding torque transmission path and stress ratio (crushing to shear stress).

criteria.title: Design Requirements & Parameters
criteria.description: Correct identification of operational power, speed, shaft diameter, and key length.

criteria.title: Engineering Assumptions Log
criteria.description: Formulation of valid engineering assumptions regarding force distribution, fit, and material limits.

criteria.title: Key Design Calculation
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of transmitted torque T, tangential force Ft, and minimum required key length.

criteria.title: Failure Analysis & Safety Verification
criteria.description: Computation of actual shear stress, crushing stress, and resulting Factor of Safety (FOS).

criteria.title: Engineering Decision & Improvements
criteria.description: Evidence-based SAFE decision with technical justification and design recommendations.

criteria.title: Engineering Report & Reflection
criteria.description: Comprehensive synthesis, failure mode reflection, and practical industrial recommendations.
